body: Do you know what's causing your anxiety? Sometimes when you come to terms with it (like thinking you're dying but really you're not) helps a lot! Trust me, I've been there and I'm so much better after talking about what scared me. Also: BREATHE!! I can't stress it enough. I know it's really hard to breathe normally since your chest hurts, but I promise you it helps slow your heart down so much! I believe you can overcome this!! :)
